description: In the lymph node a Langerhans cell shows antigen on MHC class II to naive CD4 T cells. The helper type that results depends on species and test: in mice, Langerhans cells were needed for Th17 cells against Candida skin infection, while human Langerhans cells in culture preferentially induced CD4 T cells that make Th2 cytokines. They are not needed for every response; in one mouse model, contact allergy still developed without them.
